claim: You can use X-Ray to trace Lambda functions: Lambda runs the X-Ray daemon and records a segment with details about invoking and running the function, and if the function is called by another instrumented service, Lambda traces requests that have already been sampled without any additional configuration.

evidence.quote: You can use AWS X-Ray to trace your AWS Lambda functions. Lambda runs the [X-Ray daemon](xray-daemon.md) and records a segment with details about invoking and running the function.
If your Lambda function is called by another instrumented service, Lambda traces requests that have already been sampled without any additional configuration.
